content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Tax, valuation and advisory for individuals and funds; does not manage REITs or earn fees from managed property companies."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Outsourced HR, payroll and workers' compensation for small businesses; no REIT or property management overlap."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Engineering, surveying and land development consulting sold project by project; not ongoing management of REITs."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Owns and leases office buildings and earns rent; it is an asset owner, not a manager paid by others."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Owns and leases office properties and collects tenant rent; it is an asset owner rather than a fee-based manager."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Engineering, construction and government program services; project-based work, not management of REITs."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Installs and maintains building mechanical and electrical systems; a trades and facilities service, not REIT management."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Mechanical and electrical contracting for building owners; installation-driven work, not management services to REITs."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Owns and leases office buildings to corporate tenants and earns rent; an asset owner, not a manager paid by REITs."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Insurance brokerage and program administration earning commissions; a different business from REIT management services."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Owns and operates a hotel and apartments and earns guest and tenant revenue; an owner-operator, not a REIT manager."}]}
